name: LocalPilot Initial Sources Database
description: Authoritative registry of supported model sources, registries, and download backends.

sources.name: Hugging Face Hub
sources.description: The premier global open-source AI model repository hosting hundreds of thousands of GGUF and safetensors weights.
sources.auth_instructions: Free open access for public models. A free Hugging Face user access token (Option B) is required for gated weights like Meta Llama.

sources.name: Ollama Library
sources.description: Official model registry for pre-packaged, single-command desktop models managed and run via Ollama daemon.
sources.auth_instructions: Completely open access, no account or API token required.

sources.name: Alibaba ModelScope Hub
sources.description: Comprehensive open model registry with low-latency CDN and high-speed mirrors for regional, bilingual, and Chinese models.
sources.auth_instructions: Free open weights; ModelScope SDK access token optional for accelerated enterprise bandwidth.

sources.name: LM Studio Community Hub
sources.description: Curated catalog of community-quantized models specifically optimized for desktop CPU and GPU offloading.
sources.auth_instructions: Free open access community model downloads.

sources.name: Local GGUF Models Directory
sources.description: Manually downloaded or custom fine-tuned GGUF model files placed directly in your computer's storage folder.
sources.auth_instructions: Read access to local filesystem directory.

sources.name: GitHub Releases
sources.description: Direct asset downloads from official open-source repository releases (e.g. whisper.cpp checkpoints, llama.cpp binaries).
sources.auth_instructions: Public downloads without authentication; optional GitHub PAT to bypass anonymous rate limits.

sources.name: OpenXLab Hub
sources.description: Shanghai AI Laboratory's open-source model repository hosting InternLM and InternVL multi-modal models.
sources.auth_instructions: Free open access for academic and research models.

sources.name: Kaggle Models Hub
sources.description: Community model repository hosting fine-tunes, quantizations, and competition benchmarks with verified provenance.
sources.auth_instructions: Optional Kaggle API token (kaggle.json) for authenticated access to gated competitions.

sources.name: Jan / Cortex Hub
sources.description: Curated model catalog from the open-source Jan desktop ecosystem utilizing the Cortex engine.
